bodyLines: * **highlight:** highlight should work even if the attribute is missing (algolia/react-instantsearch#1791) ([f9d3f9e](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/f9d3f9e)), closes [#1790](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/1790)

* **widgets:** add 300px width for the default SearchBox (algolia/react-instantsearch#1803) ([1826ebb](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/1826ebb))
